description: Search the full public MCP Index. The tools on this connection are only the Index, not the catalog. Pass the job as query. Optional host is cursor, copilot, or vscode. Each match includes a slug and tool names. Run one with call_indexed_tool.

host.description: Optional product host, same as the public Index query: cursor, copilot, vscode.

limit.description: How many matches to return. Default 20, maximum 50.

query.description: Words an agent would type. Empty returns the directory in stored order.

section.description: Section name from list_sections. Partial names match.

status.description: Exact facts.status value from this directory: operational, degraded, down, auth_required, unrated.

name: search_records
title: Search the MCP Index
